Recognise 1971 genocide
2024-05-28T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/recognise-1971-genocide-3620556

Chief Justice Obaidul Hassan yesterday stressed the need for international recognition of the genocide committed in Bangladesh during the Liberation War.

"It's a matter of sorrow that the undemocratic governments had rehabilitated the war criminals through bringing them back into mainstream politics in different ways. Even at that time, the history of our Liberation War had been distorted. As a result, no steps were taken from the state level for international recognition of the 1971 genocide." he said.

"But, better late than never. Now is the right time to demand international recognition of the 1971 genocide," he said.

He said this while speaking as chief guest at a workshop titled "International Recognition of the 1971 Bangladesh Genocide".

The programme was jointly organised by Dhaka University, University College of London and Centre for Genocide Studies at DU.

He said the international recognition will be achieved when the UN General Assembly or the Security Council adopts a resolution in this regard.
